content.text: SPONSORED BackBiographyAwardsTriviaFAQIMDbProAll topicsTriviaBilly BushEditBilly Bush is first cousin of former US President George W. Bush, Jeb Bush, Neil Bush, Marvin Bush and Doro Bush and the nephew of former US President George H.W. Bush.Suspended by NBC for his 2005 interview of Donald Trump where both of them engaged in conversations of sexual encounters they've had and would like to have with various women.[October 2005].He earned a bachelor's degree in International Studies and Government at Colby College in Waterville, Maine.Daughter Lillie Bush born October 17th, 2004Has two daughters, Josephine and Mary Bradley, with wife Sydney.Hosted the radio morning show, Billy Bush and The Bush League Morning Show on WWZZ-FM (Z104) in Washington, DC until 2001.Currently resides in New York City.Promoted to co-anchor of Access Hollywood (1996).As host for Access Hollywood he was contracted for $3 million a year.First cousin, once removed, of Barbara Bush, Jenna Bush Hager and Lauren Bush Lauren.Hired Marshall Grossman, a prominent Los Angeles attorney to negotiate a settlement with NBC on either Bush's departure from his position as new anchor with the network or a continuation of his employment with a new contract.[October 2005].He was a two-time captain of the Mens' Colby College Lacrosse team.A registered independent.Practices yoga.Attended high school with Julie Bowen.Hosts his own podcast on YouTube titled, ''Hot Mics with Billy Bush'' (2025).Contribute to this pageSuggest an edit or add missing contentLearn more about contributingEdit pageMore from this personOther worksPublicity listingsExternal sitesFAQ More to exploreListStaff Picks: What to Watch in AprilSee our picks SPONSORED PhotosActors' Early RolesSee the galleryUser listsRelated lists from IMDb usersCreate a listCelebrities Names That Start With B created 8 years ago • 50 peopleStar Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones 2002 premierecreated 6 years ago • 46 peopleRoad to Perdition 2002 (NY) premierecreated 6 years ago • 39 peopleThe 62nd Annual Golden Globe Awards 2005 premierecreated 5 years ago • 463 peopleStar Wars: Episode VII -
